verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's official CLI documents a `scrapingbee schedule` command for cron-based scheduled jobs. That is a first-party recurring-schedule capability, not a one-off action, so it can run scraping automations unattended. It is labeled a gated advanced feature and is described only in a single table line, so its depth is unproven. Missing for 10: details on whether schedules run server-side in ScrapingBee or depend on the user's machine, job management and monitoring, failure handling, availability terms of the gated feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
